items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: That's where I first met Benny Carter. ... Has he got the record "BBB"? Benny Carter, Ben Webster, and Barney Bigard?

ctx.x: Well, later when you tried playing the trumpet, did you think you would like it or not?

Well, I was too far gone on the clarinet then, you know, and I didn't want to start that trumpet all over again, so I -- if I did, I would just be just to play it a player like, probably like Benny Carter would, you know, [crossed out]. I wouldn't want to stay with it, I don't think. But otherwise, all right.
